bio: Stefano Bragadin, the enigma of Venice's waterfront, has transformed from a simple porter to one of the most prosperous facchini in La Serenissima's history. Working at the Public Dock at Riva degli Scalpellini with calloused hands and watchful eyes, Stefano has accumulated over 466,000 ducats through an intricate web of silent investments and unmatched knowledge of shipping patterns.
